notes_for_editor: Thin record: one substantive page (a Forest Lookouts entry that is mostly a navigation list, with a callout of two 1973-80 notes and an undated Removed label) plus an OpenStreetMap point. No build date, height, design, fires or current site description found. A second OSM node (367805749) repeats the name with a USGS Geonames tag and was not used. A topo-map listing returned HTTP 403 and was not read. Two searches surfaced no other Northampton-specific source. The SC Forestry Commission history page covers state towers and does not mention Northampton. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the fiscal-year dates now appear in the evidence quotes (taken from the page's year headings), and the South Carolina header and OSM tower:type tag are quoted.
